name: flicopy
title: Flicopy
description: Take screenshots, scrolling screenshots, recordings and copy text from the screen with Flicopy.
author: wanzhi0810

commands.name: capture-area
commands.title: Capture Area
commands.subtitle: Flicopy
commands.description: Select an area of the screen and capture it.

commands.name: capture-window
commands.title: Capture Window
commands.subtitle: Flicopy
commands.description: Pick a window and capture it.

commands.name: capture-previous-area
commands.title: Capture Previous Area
commands.subtitle: Flicopy
commands.description: Capture the same area as last time.

commands.name: capture-area-after-delay
commands.title: Capture Area After Delay
commands.subtitle: Flicopy
commands.description: Select an area and capture it after a countdown.

commands.name: capture-and-annotate-area
commands.title: Capture and Annotate Area
commands.subtitle: Flicopy
commands.description: Capture an area and mark it up in place.

commands.name: capture-scrolling-screenshot
commands.title: Capture Scrolling Screenshot
commands.subtitle: Flicopy
commands.description: Capture a long page or chat as one image while it scrolls.

commands.name: capture-element
commands.title: Capture Element
commands.subtitle: Flicopy
commands.description: Capture a single interface element, such as a button, card or table.

commands.name: capture-subject
commands.title: Capture Subject Without Background
commands.subtitle: Flicopy
commands.description: Capture the subject of an image with its background removed.

commands.name: copy-text-from-screen
commands.title: Copy Text from Screen
commands.subtitle: Flicopy
commands.description: Select an area and copy the text in it (OCR).

commands.name: open-all-in-one
commands.title: Open All-in-One
commands.subtitle: Flicopy
commands.description: Open the toolbar that combines every capture mode.

commands.name: record-screen
commands.title: Record Screen
commands.subtitle: Flicopy
commands.description: Record the screen or an area of it.

commands.name: toggle-quick-panel
commands.title: Toggle Quick Panel
commands.subtitle: Flicopy
commands.description: Open or close the Quick Panel with everything you copied and captured.

commands.name: pick-color
commands.title: Pick Color
commands.subtitle: Flicopy
commands.description: Pick a color from anywhere on the screen.

commands.name: combine-selected-images
commands.title: Combine Selected Images
commands.subtitle: Flicopy
commands.description: Combine the images selected in Finder into one image in Flicopy.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
